title: Look outside
intro: Let your eyes wander somewhere far from the screen.

prompts.text: Find the farthest thing you can see and rest your eyes on it.
Watch the sky for a minute. What is it doing?
Count how many different greens you can see.
Find something that moves, like a leaf, a cloud or a person walking.
Pick one small detail on a distant building.
Look left, then right, then up, slowly.
Notice the light: where is it brightest, and where is it soft?
Find three shapes out there: a square, a circle and a triangle.
Blink slowly a few times, then look at something far away again.
Watch the weather for a moment without any need to judge it.
If there is no window, look at the farthest corner of the room.

backAtDesk: Welcome back. The view will still be there next time.
